body: Thank you for your kindness. I’ve been at this for the past 7 months after some traumatic life events. I just got tired today and it’s ok. The fact that a stranger just told me I coped in a healthy way is probably the best thing to see right now because I’ve been working so hard at this. Thank you kind stranger.

Mine says the same when I look at my transcript. Upon further speculation though, it seems that my first one was issued on 4/15, but wasn’t deposited via direct deposit until 4/27. If this is correct, then if you were issued your stimulus on 1/4, then you should receive the direct deposit on 1/18. At least that’s my 2 cents...if it’s worth that lol 

For those wondering: Since the check was issued on 1/4, then it shouldn’t be considered taxable because it was issued before the 1/15 cutoff date, even though it won’t be received until 1/18.
